reason: The returns and UL listing are better than I expected, but I've never heard of them and $360 is a lot for a pendant from a store with almost no reviews. I'd save it to my dining room board and keep comparing for a few months before buying anything.
objection: Brand nobody knows, hardly any reviews, and I can't tell if a $360 paper pendant looks as good in my room as in the photos.
would_change_my_mind: A bunch of verified reviews with real customer photos of the pendant hanging in a home, or a cheap swatch/sample so I can see the material in person.
